source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

mx.teacher_note: Given point is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Draw a line parallel to a given line through a given point' is answered as given point rather than given line.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Given point is what produces given line, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Draw a line parallel to a given line through a given.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: given line is settled by running 'Read and use the diagram notation for parallel and perpendicular': Arrow marks show lines that are parallel; different numbers of arrow marks distinguish — on the item about Draw a line parallel to a given line through a given.

mx.name: operation_confusion
mx.teacher_note: Given line is computed by squaring given point and leaving given line linear, so the written value is 33 — on the item about Draw a line parallel to a given line through a given.

intelligence.enrichment: A parallel line through a point can be constructed by keeping the same angle relationship to a reference line, such as sliding a set square or folding two perpendicular creases so the new line has equal corresponding right angles.
